mathematics: Independent checks cover endpoint differences, positive norms, dimensionless normalization, signed combinations, equilibrants, quadrant reconstruction, active rotation matrices, exact standard-angle components, scalar dot products, angle cosines, projection residual perpendicularity, target-zero conditions, signed work, a separate determinant oracle for cross products, antisymmetry and Lagrange's identity, triangle/parallelogram area, ordered torque, all-coordinate line membership, plane residual normalization, and coordinate reconstruction including axial/origin ambiguity. Families use 100 seeds per structure, lessons and screens 50.
instruction: Five original lessons provide quick recall and full explanation routes, 33 reasoned examples, guided work, five prediction activities, varied practice, independent checkpoints, and targeted routing. Existing F04 exact trigonometric utilities and generic exact/rational graders are reused without changing source lesson or attempt identities.
accessibility: No Axe WCAG 2 A/AA or WCAG 2.1 AA violations, horizontal overflow, or KaTeX errors in the browser journeys. All activities and guided work operate by keyboard. Diagrams use equal axis scales, distinct line styles, separate legends, numeric tables, and point markers for zero vectors. Desktop overview and revised mobile addition/projection screenshots were inspected.
sources: Six precise free OpenStax Calculus Volume 3 sections (2.1–2.5 and 2.7) were verified and attributed in resources.json. Prose, exercises, and diagrams are original. Right-handed Cartesian axes, degree ranges, and the spherical azimuth/inclination convention are explicit.
